Definition: adverb from the same as G1595; voluntarily:--wilfully, willingly.
BiblicalUsage: Hekousios means willingly, and it appears twice, once as a command and once as a warning. In 1 Peter 5:2 the elders are to feed the flock willingly and not by constraint, and in Hebrews 10:26 the one who sins wilfully after receiving the knowledge of the truth has no more sacrifice for sins.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two verses belong together: willingness is the mark of a true shepherd, and wilfulness is the mark of a heart that has stopped listening; the same word, turned toward God or away from him, is either obedience or rebellion.
